scenes.setting: The iron-mask gathering: the fat-faced apothecary hires a sewer-beast cleaner; old Eye of Wisdom pays 400 pounds for Meursault's crimson 'jelly'; no one dares bodyguard against a Sequence 6 — so Black Snake tempts Klein with an ominous item that lets one hear the voice of a great being. Deal.
scenes.text_anchor: “I repeat, I need someone to clean up the newly appeared beast in the sewers.
